job.title: Job Application for Senior Manager, Data Science at Upstart

roles.title: Senior Analytical Lead, then Analytical Director

requirements.text: 10+ years of experience in data science and analytics, including 5+ years managing teams of analysts and data scientists.
Technical depth across the core work of marketing analytics and data science, including reporting, experimentation, causal inference, and attribution, plus the judgment to choos…
Working knowledge of SQL and Python, with the ability to review your team’s work directly.
A track record of hiring strong talent and helping people grow into more senior roles.
Clear written and verbal communication with marketing, finance, product, and technical audiences, and the confidence to tell senior leaders when the evidence doesn’t support a p…
Strong judgment in ambiguous, greenfield areas: the ability to frame questions the business hasn’t asked yet and assess whether they’re worth pursuing.
At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, …
At Upstart, a marketing dollar creates value when it reaches someone our AI models approve who goes on to take out a loan. That means our work goes well beyond clicks. Because w…
As the Senior Manager for our Marketing Data Science team, you’ll lead this team and work directly with Upstart’s marketing leaders. You’ll be a thought partner, helping the bus…
Lead a team of analysts and data scientists embedded across marketing channels, with end-to-end ownership of their work.
Make experimentation central to the team’s approach: prioritize high-value tests across channels and ensure the findings inform what marketing does next.
Guide the team in understanding why channel performance changes and translating those insights into clear, actionable recommendations.
Encourage proactive analysis that surfaces emerging risks and opportunities before stakeholders ask.
Set a high bar for measurement, including incrementality testing and attribution, and ensure the team delivers rigorous, high-quality work.
Partner with marketing, finance, and product leaders to shape the team’s roadmap, bringing business context back to the team so it can focus on the right problems.
Hire, develop, and retain a strong team that marketing leaders see as a trusted partner, not just a reporting service.
If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.
Marketing Science is part of Upstart’s Growth, Product, and Ops Analytics team. We help answer two important questions: Is our marketing working, and where should we invest next?
A PhD or master’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, or another quantitative field.
Experience incorporating AI tools into a team’s analysis and reporting workflows.
Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote
